_notes: UQM 0.8.0's own lander among hazards, recorded as lander-creatures.json is, with PlanetSide's chances of quakes, lightning and lava from the world's tectonics, weather and temperature (GetHazardChance, GetThermalHazardRating), and contact found by UQM's own DrawablesIntersect with the masks of graphics.lander, graphics.quake, graphics.lightning, graphics.lavaspot, graphics.miscdata, graphics.lifecan and graphics.life.0 to 25 from the official content package (SHA-256 77d75ac25e6fb755a33c4ba3b38a7b7bc41fcbc02896891b0cc9ac9214b72eef). Positions and events come from code and the masks' shapes; no content.

Landings on real worlds with their nodes (world-STAR-PLANET-MOON's report and nodes in world-surfaces.json): the shakiest, the stormiest, stormy and hot, hot with life, and one with all three; on that one with 6 crew, bare, with every shield (8 biological, 16 quake, 32 lightning, 64 lava) and with each hazard's shield alone; on a hot world, with quakes too, at each pole and either side of the east-west edge; on two milder worlds, without and with every shield; taking off at once; and two long landings with every shield (crowded-*) among so many hazards that UQM's display queue fills (MAX_DISPLAY_ELEMENTS, 150 nodes and all).

input and frames as in lander-creatures.json; a hazard's element is [x, y, life_span, playerNr, mass_points (1 a quake, 2 lightning, 0 harmless lightning, 3 lava), sheet (1 graphics.quake, 2 graphics.lightning, 3 graphics.lavaspot), frame, facing, turn_wait].
chances: every orbited world's [star, planet, moon (-1 the planet), [TectonicsChance, WeatherChance, FireChance]], out of 256 a frame, as PlanetSide sets them from the world's report.
